supersededRuns: Initial chapter routes stopped after the new physical-AI modifier defect was reproduced. Their partial victories and pre-fix hashes are not used for final success. Both final routes were run from the beginning against the fixed candidate.
orchestrationRecovery: The waiting shell script was edited while running, so its post-wait offset became invalid (sert:command not found). All18victories and5new supplementals had already passed. Started an immutable finish script, retaining all real results; no game or test assertion changed.
legacyTransitTimingFix: The existing650ms automatic transit could remove the optional skip button between visibility check and tap. The legacy touch test now bounds the optional action to1000ms and requires both button removal and the exact requested destination on expiry. Original resource/state assertions and dedicated actual-skip tests remain. Failed route rerun; a successful independent second route is retained only against the unchanged production candidate.
contactHelperFix: The test helper now captures battle/world state in one evaluation, avoiding a transition between a world-existence check and a disposed-world state read. No app behavior, timeout or functional assertion changed. A completed before route is retained and the failed after route is rerun in full.
legacyPopupSampling: Legacy side-view tests capture the actual DOM popup, canvas plan and new battle-event identity in one MutationObserver sample before the existing850ms display ends. Original exact target, healing, critical, MISS and counter assertions remain; no game timer or timeout changed. The skill UI passed its unchanged checks when isolated.
finalUnitRecheckRecovery: A final unit recheck was initially launched concurrently with screenshot capture and hit unchanged5000ms limits in long seeded legacy cases. That recheck was stopped and recorded as aborted; after capture/build finish the complete npm test suite is rerun alone. No test timeout, assertion or game data changed.

initialBrowserFailures.reason: After reloading a legacy-location puzzle, the test reopened the event but did not advance the safe pre-puzzle dialogue. The game showed page1/2 as expected. Added the same dialogue advancement used on initial entry; assertions and timeout unchanged. Both complete routes rerun.

Both fixed-candidate routes reached the final boss, but the UI bot prioritized neutral ice instead of the documented wind weakness (thunder). The first stopped at round61 with203/6400enemyHP and all3allies alive after the unchanged180-command budget. Aligned spell choice with the seeded unit strategy; assertions, timeout and command budget unchanged. Both routes rerun from the beginning. An engine-only20-seed strategy probe found thunder alone could still exceed180 commands (168–211). The final UI strategy uses shield bash for pressure and conserves half of Mei’s MP for healing after exploiting wind weakness (139–169 commands,20/20victories). No game-stat, timeout, victory assertion or action-budget change. Thunder-only partial reruns were stopped during the second battle and are excluded from final proof.

The test replaced localStorage while a live map remained mounted. The existing pagehide flush correctly saved that live severed state over the projected fixture. Dispose the map through its normal Home action before installing the next isolated fixture; no save/game logic or assertion changed. Rerun all4stages.

Stage setup was corrected and severed/projected passed. The same mounted-map replacement problem also existed in the separate bridge-coordinate injection: valid connected coordinates were overwritten by the live pose on pagehide. Dispose normally before that injection too; keep exact before/after coordinate assertions unchanged. Rerun all4stages.

Optional skip tap raced the existing650ms automatic transit. Screenshot/log show the correct ark-shore destination after the button detached. The test now bounds the optional tap to1000ms; if it expires, additionally asserts the button is absent and the requested map was reached. Original map/party/equipment/win/battle assertions remain, and dedicated transit/railway tests still require actual skip input. No game timer or assertion threshold changed. Failed before path rerun; successful after path may be retained if it completes. The original after path also reached chapter clear (all6real victories) but hit the same expired optional skip during post-clear quests; its whole path remains failed and is not reused as a successful route. Both paths are rerun from the beginning using the fixed UI procedure.

The contact helper checked world existence and then read world state in separate evaluations. The game entered battle between them; screenshot/log show a healthy live battle while the test waited30s for the disposed world. Read battle/world state atomically instead; no game logic, timeout, victory or arrival assertion changed. The fully successful fixed before path is retained; only failed after path rerun from the beginning.
The dev fixture page.goto hit the unchanged30s navigation timeout while other browser jobs were active. Rerun alone against the same source before considering a code change.

The battle snapshot correctly contained two21damage hits andMP16, but the later DOM popup count was0 instead of2. Recheck alone to distinguish the850ms display lifetime from a logic regression; no assertion or timeout changed.

The isolated retry loaded correctly and passed canvas/weapon/event checks, then waited for MISS after the850ms DOM popup expired. The test now observes a new event identity and captures the actual rendered DOM, event and canvas plan together via MutationObserver. All original hit/target/heal/critical/MISS/counter values remain asserted; game timer, data and timeouts unchanged. Full side-view test rerun.
